isa95.mappingNote: These are live machine signals of EUROMAP 77 (cycle, pressures, temperatures, mould, dryer, hopper, energy) plus the machine type string of the source. B2MML Equipment has no named field for them; a value would only sit in a generic EquipmentProperty. Audit M3 (core 6.0.0): the setpoints and planned values (Set_Temp_Dryer, Set_Time_DryerResidence) are equipment properties of the machine (Equipment.EquipmentProperty, named by their ID); the live Level-2 signals stay outside ISA-95. Core 6.0.0 (owner 29.10.2026): the signals every machine shares (status, mode, alarms, uptime, shift flag, power) live on SMProfile-Machine.
